text: 中国汽车工业协会副秘书长陈士华对外表示，2026年，我国汽车出口预计保持增长，全年出口量有望超过1000万辆。
text_en: Chen Shihua, deputy secretary-general of the China Association of Automobile Manufacturers, said that in 2026, China's automobile exports are expected to maintain growth, with full-year export volume expected to exceed 10 million units.
